name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, created the example script per the docs, and verified text-to-speech generates a valid audio file. The API call returned audio data which was saved to output.mp3 (40,586 bytes, confirmed as MPEG ADTS layer III MP3 at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz).
deviations: The quickstart's `play(audio)` example plays audio through speakers, but this sandbox has no audio output device. To verify the promised outcome (generating an audio file from text), I adapted the script to save the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead of playing it. This is a minimal deviation that still validates the core API functionality exactly as documented.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
